label: lem:continuous_integrable
title: Continuous functions are interval integrable
statement: If $f : \mathbb{R} \to E$ is continuous on the interval $[\min(a,b), \max(a,b)]$, then $f$ is interval integrable on $[a, b]$ with respect to the given measure. In Mathlib this is \texttt{ContinuousOn.intervalIntegrable}.
proof: A continuous function on a compact interval is bounded and measurable, hence integrable with respect to the Lebesgue measure. The result follows from the fact that continuous functions on compact sets are integrable.
